configuration.replay: First seed and replicate for every team

limitations: Finite prespecified seed coverage is not exhaustive verification.
Autocompleted drafts exercise one CPU policy; adversarial user trades are covered separately by domain/API tests.
Structural consistency does not establish forecast calibration, causal validity, exact NFL tiebreakers or complete historical rosters.
Monte Carlo replicate indices are fixed; failures are retained and never resampled.
